title: Create a premium street-food advertising poster for a fic...
prompt:
Create a premium street-food advertising poster for a fictional gourmet shawarma brand called "Bashan", featuring one oversized upright shawarma wrap as the absolute visual hero. Preserve the core visual logic of a bold typographic food poster: a single shawarma standing vertically in the center foreground, wrapped in branded paper, overflowing with chargrilled meat, fresh vegetables, and creamy sauce, set against a deep near-black background with monumental distressed cream-beige headline typography behind it. The final image must merge Transit restraint and Orbit energy: the composition should stay clean, bold, and product-led, while heat, smoke, sauce flow, and food highlights subtly guide the eye upward through the wrap.

Style:
ultra-realistic commercial food photography, premium fast-casual advertising, flagship street-food poster, photographed not illustrated, macro-detail realism, cinematic black-and-gold mood, no CGI look.

Core composition:
Use a tall vertical poster composition. Place one giant shawarma wrap upright in the center, dominating the frame from lower middle to upper middle. Let the wrap overlap huge background typography so the food immediately becomes the first visual focus. Keep the background deep, dark, and uncluttered, with only minimal smoke, warm side glow, and a few restrained ember particles. Preserve a strong hierarchy: hero wrap first, giant typography second, very limited supporting copy third.

Transit restraint:
Reduce non-essential visual noise. Keep side notes, badges, and bottom information minimal. Preserve large negative dark areas around the main product and let the typography feel architectural rather than busy. The image should read like an international flagship food poster: fewer elements, stronger authority, cleaner hierarchy.

Orbit motion logic:
Create a subtle but clear flow from the lower wrapped base upward through the filling. Let rising heat haze, faint smoke, the direction of sauce drips, the angle of meat edges, and the arrangement of vegetables all guide the eye upward and outward from the center opening. The whole wrap should feel hot, alive, and just opened, with appetite energy radiating from the top.

Hero product:
Design one luxurious shawarma wrap with a lightly charred flatbread exterior, tightly folded around a generous filling of grilled chicken or mixed meat, crisp lettuce, diced tomato, cucumber, red onion, herbs, and creamy white garlic-yogurt sauce. The top opening must feel abundant, juicy, and freshly assembled, with layered ingredients clearly visible and packed densely.

Wrap and texture:
The flatbread must show blistered brown char marks, toasted golden patches, soft fold creases, and realistic flour-dry texture. The paper sleeve around the lower half should feel crinkled, slightly grease-touched, and premium, printed with original graphic branding elements in an elegant street-luxury style. The wrap must feel substantial, hot, and handheld-real.

Typography and layout:
Place giant distressed cream-beige block letters behind the shawarma using original English wording such as:
BASAHN
SIGNATURE
Let the text be oversized, vertically stacked, and partially hidden by the wrap. Add only one restrained accent line in a warm golden brush or condensed style, such as:
BOLD BITE
Keep supporting copy extremely sparse, for example:
JUICY. CHARRED. REAL.
and a minimal brand sign-off:
Bashan
ESTD 2026
No cluttered copy blocks, no excessive labels.

Lighting:
Use dramatic warm food lighting from upper left and slightly behind, creating glossy highlights on the grilled meat, creamy sheen on the sauce, and soft rim light on the flatbread edges. Add gentle frontal fill only to preserve readability. The background should remain dark with a subtle amber haze. The wrap must feel hotter, more tactile, and more premium than the surroundings.

Materials:
Render the grilled meat with caramelized edges, charred corners, juicy fibers, and light oil sheen. Render the vegetables crisp and fresh with realistic moisture. Render the white sauce thick, creamy, and naturally flowing. Render the flatbread with toasted bubbles, scorched spots, and soft fold tension. Render the paper sleeve with fiber texture, printed ink detail, and light grease absorption. Add only a few crumbs and tiny ember-like particles.

Color palette:
Use a disciplined palette of deep black, warm beige typography, toasted brown flatbread, golden-brown grilled meat, creamy white sauce, restrained lettuce green, tomato red, and warm ember-gold highlights. Keep the shawarma as the richest and brightest object in the frame.

Atmosphere:
The mood must feel bold, hot, craveable, urban, premium, smoky, and unforgettable. The poster should balance street-food energy with luxury advertising precision, making the wrap feel iconic and instantly desirable.

Quality and physical rules:
extreme detail, realistic grilled texture, realistic sauce viscosity, crisp vegetable detail, clean typography edges, deep clean blacks, no muddy shadows, no blown highlights, no extra food props, no human figure, no distorted wrap shape, no fake CGI texture, no cluttered layout.

Negative prompt:
copied text, existing brand names, watermark, extra props, fries, drinks, human hands, messy composition, plastic-looking sauce, fake grilled meat texture, low-resolution food detail, muddy blacks, overexposed highlights, illustration style, CGI render look, unreadable typography, distorted wrap geometry, cluttered poster elements

title: ADIDAS — “BREAK THE PATTERN”
prompt:
ADIDAS — “BREAK THE PATTERN”

Format: Vertical 4:5 Social Hero Poster
Style: Premium sports campaign × contemporary editorial photography × surreal architecture × bold graphic design
Quality: Hyper-realistic, 8K, commercial campaign photography

CORE IDEA

Athletes spend years repeating the same movements until repetition becomes instinct.

Instead of showing the athlete running through a normal environment, visualize routine breaking apart around them.

Create a massive minimalist concrete training space where the floor is divided into hundreds of repeating geometric sections. As the athlete moves forward, those sections physically lift, rotate and rearrange into a new pathway.

The world changes because the athlete refuses to follow the expected pattern.

HERO ATHLETE

Young professional female runner captured mid-stride.

Natural athletic physique, realistic skin and subtle sweat, focused expression, loose hair reacting to movement.

She wears:

* Black adidas performance top
* Black lightweight running shorts
* White performance socks
* Modern adidas running shoes with recognizable three-stripe detailing

No exaggerated muscles or fashion-model posing. She should look like a real athlete captured during training.

ENVIRONMENT

Minimal white and concrete architectural space with enormous geometric walls and open negative space.

Hundreds of rectangular floor panels create a precise grid. Some panels remain flat while others rise into ramps, walls and suspended pathways, creating a controlled impossible landscape.

A thin blue accent line follows the athlete’s route through the environment.

No random floating objects, fantasy scenery or psychedelic effects.

COMPOSITION

Keep the athlete as the visual anchor.

Use the architectural grid to create strong leading lines toward her.

Large portions of the poster remain clean and minimal, while selected sections contain oversized graphic elements, distance markers and cropped numbers.

TYPOGRAPHY

Large bold condensed typography integrated into the architecture:

BREAK
THE
PATTERN

Make PATTERN the dominant word.

Supporting copy:

DON’T FOLLOW THE LINE.
CREATE YOUR OWN.

Small technical elements:

ADIDAS RUNNING / 01
PACE — PROGRESSIVE
DISTANCE — 10K
MODE — FORWARD

Bottom CTA:

RUN DIFFERENT →

Add a thin blue horizontal strip:

RUN / TRAIN / PUSH / REPEAT / EVOLVE

PRODUCT

The adidas running shoe should be highly realistic and naturally integrated into the action.

Visible engineered mesh, stitching, outsole texture and realistic material deformation.

The three-stripe branding should be clean and correctly proportioned without becoming oversized.

LIGHTING & CAMERA

Bright directional daylight entering from above, producing sharp architectural shadows and natural reflections.

Professional sports photography, 50mm lens, slightly low camera position, fast shutter speed, realistic depth of field and subtle cinematic grain.

Natural skin tones. Clean whites. Deep blacks. Controlled blue accent.

FINAL LOOK

The result should feel like a global adidas performance campaign photographed inside an impossible architectural training facility.

Minimal, energetic, youthful and conceptual.

No generic sneaker ad.
No catalogue photography.
No random AI surrealism.
No excessive graphics.
No luxury-fashion aesthetic.
No fake CGI appearance.

title: [BRAND]: [Brand Name]
prompt:
[BRAND]: [Brand Name]
[PRODUCT]: [Food Or Dessert Or Bread]
[HEADLINE]: [Headline]
[INTERACTION]: [Interaction]
[ACCENT COLOR]: [Accent Color]
[DETAILS]: [Details]

Create a 9:16 vertical food editorial poster combining highly realistic food photography with bold, professionally designed typography.

Use a warm cream or ivory background, subtle paper texture, clean editorial composition and minimal props.

Keep [HEADLINE] large, rigid, sharp and readable. The typography acts as a real physical environment while the food reacts to it according to [INTERACTION].

For “cold-set,” let a warm liquid food contact cold typography and visibly change from glossy liquid to semi-set, then matte solid only where contact occurs.

For “heat-melt,” let a solid food such as butter touch hot typography and realistically soften, melt, foam and change color along the contact path.

For “liquid containment,” use letter counters or low typographic boundaries to collect a real liquid into visible pools with depth, meniscus and controlled overflow.

For “constrained growth,” let a soft expanding food such as dough grow against rigid letters, flatten at contact points, squeeze into narrow gaps and expand again where space opens.

Every reaction must follow clear physical cause and effect. Keep the typography unchanged while the food’s shape, flow or material state responds to it.

Use [ACCENT COLOR] with natural food colors and dark neutrals. Add only a few useful details such as [BRAND], product name, ingredients, one short line of copy, opening hours and address.

Avoid food-shaped letters, fake digital effects, random drips, exaggerated 3D typography, CGI materials, numbered labels, 01/02, Vol. or sparkles.

The final poster should work as a stop-scroll image: one bold headline, one recognizable food element and one immediately understandable physical reaction.

Create a Cannes-level premium four-panel skincare campaign board for a fictional beauty brand called LUMERA SKIN, merging Orbit atmosphere with Transit material precision while slightly reducing the density of callout stickers and copy blocks. Strictly preserve the reference image’s core 2x2 social-poster structure: four square panels arranged in a balanced grid, two alternating hero products, two adult female beauty portraits, one unified color family, and a clear commercial hierarchy that makes every panel instantly readable while feeling more refined, more international, and more luxurious.

Overall board structure: design a perfectly proportioned four-quadrant campaign board with clean panel divisions, strong rhythm, and one coherent brand system running through all four images. Alternate between two product categories: a radiant vitamin-C face cream jar in the top-left and bottom-right panels, and a sculptural SPF 50 sun-care stick in the top-right and bottom-left panels. Use two adult female models with distinct but compatible beauty identities. The board must feel like one cohesive award-level skincare launch rather than four disconnected posts.

Top-left panel: intimate close beauty portrait of an adult curly-haired woman with visible freckles, luminous skin, soft lips, and expressive eyes. She holds a warm yellow vitamin-C cream jar close to her cheek. The palette is golden, creamy, and sunlit, with a warm editorial mood. Place one large headline in the upper area, one circular quantity badge, and only one or two slim benefit capsules rather than many scattered info elements. Keep the layout airy, elegant, and premium.

Top-right panel: bright, fresh portrait of an adult woman with clean pulled-back hair and naturally glowing skin, smiling while holding a rounded yellow SPF stick near her cheek. Use a clean sunlit yellow background with soft organic shapes. Include one strong headline block near the top and one large SPF claim in the lower third, with no extra clutter beyond one restrained circular quantity badge. The mood should feel joyful, summer-ready, and elevated.

Bottom-left panel: a second SPF panel that echoes the top-right but shifts slightly into a softer lilac-yellow campaign variation, keeping the same product and model family while introducing a calmer pastel contrast. Maintain the same structural DNA but do not duplicate the pose exactly. Let the lighting remain fresh and beauty-clean, with only minimal supporting copy and one restrained information strip if needed for balance.

Bottom-right panel: a second vitamin-C cream panel with a more editorial crop and stronger product emphasis. Show the same or closely related curly-haired adult beauty model in a tighter glow-focused portrait, with the yellow jar enlarged in the lower-right zone and a premium cream texture swatch tile or inset near the product. Use one large headline cluster and one or two elegant benefit markers only. Keep the panel sophisticated, glossy, and materially rich.

Product and packaging design: invent elegant premium packaging for LUMERA SKIN. The vitamin-C cream jar should be sunny yellow with creamy ivory or soft gold detailing, refined serif-sans brand typography, and a rich but clean skincare identity. The SPF 50 stick should be a rounded pebble-shaped yellow container with minimalist premium labeling and tactile cosmetic realism. Both products must feel highly manufacturable, distinctive, and beautiful. Label text must be crisp, readable, and elegantly limited.

Orbit mood: infuse the entire board with a soft “summer morning skincare diary” atmosphere. Let the yellow and lilac palette feel more breathable, airy, and emotionally warm. The models should feel naturally alive rather than posed like generic ad stock. Build a gentle sense of sunlight, optimism, and skin confidence across the campaign while maintaining high-end brand polish.

Transit precision: push material realism to a world-class commercial standard. Emphasize premium jar and stick surfaces, label clarity, cream texture density, subtle gloss on plastic or coated packaging, realistic cream swatch folds, skin microtexture, pores, natural freckles, hydrated cheekbone reflections, lip detail, brow hairs, and finger anatomy. Hands holding products must be elegant, realistic, and fully correct. Lighting must be beauty-clean and controlled, with crisp highlight placement and no muddy skin rendering.

Typography and information system: use original English-only campaign copy. Create large editorial headlines such as “C DAILY RITUAL” for the vitamin-C panels and “SUNSCREEN, REFINED” for the SPF panels. Supporting copy should be concise, premium, and limited, for example one short claim row and one quantity badge rather than dense clusters of stickers. Typography must remain bold, graphic, and commercially effective, but cleaner and less crowded than the reference. The result should feel more expensive because of restraint.

Color direction: build the campaign around 45% citrus yellow, marigold, and soft golden cream, 25% skin beige and ivory, 20% lilac and lavender pastel support tones, and 10% soft charcoal, white, and champagne highlight accents. Keep the entire board visually unified and elegant, with each panel carrying a slightly different emotional temperature inside the same brand world.

PHASE 1: CONCEPTUAL FRAMEWORK

Create a premium Trident chewing gum advertising poster built around one instantly understandable visual idea.

The advertisement should transform the simple act of chewing gum into a visually exciting experience. Think beyond conventional food advertising. Use a strong visual metaphor where freshness, flavor, confidence, connection, or an unexpected burst of sensation becomes a physical part of the environment.

The creative idea must be:

* Original
* Visually surprising
* Instantly understandable
* Social-media optimized
* Premium
* Playful but sophisticated
* Commercially believable
* Strong enough to work without excessive copy

Do not create a generic chewing-gum advertisement. Avoid random fruit explosions, generic mint leaves, floating products, excessive splashes, meaningless CGI, or stereotypical AI surrealism.

PHASE 2: PRODUCT & PACKAGING

Use the supplied Trident product packaging as the exact product reference.

Preserve:

* Exact package shape
* Brand logo
* Typography
* Colors
* Flavor name
* Product proportions
* Packaging graphics
* Wrapper details
* Material finish
* Product quantity where visible

The packaging must remain physically accurate and immediately recognizable.

Make the Trident pack the hero object of the composition.

If individual gum pieces are shown, maintain realistic proportions, wrapper construction, texture, folds, and material behavior.

Never redesign the packaging or invent product claims.

PHASE 3: CREATIVE VISUAL WORLD

Build an imaginative physical environment around the Trident product.

The environment should visually communicate the product benefit or flavor through a clever advertising metaphor.

Examples of creative territory:

* A wave of cool freshness physically transforming a city
* A mint-powered breeze bending an entire environment
* A giant flavor landscape emerging from one tiny piece of gum
* A frozen world breaking apart around the product
* A mundane social environment suddenly becoming vibrant
* Architectural forms shaped by the movement of fresh air
* An impossible miniature world contained inside the gum pack

The visual world should feel intentionally art-directed, not randomly surreal.

PHASE 4: BRAND COLOR & VISUAL IDENTITY

Use Trident’s established visual identity as the foundation.

Prioritize the actual product packaging as the primary color reference.

Where appropriate, incorporate Trident’s recognizable cool cyan/blue visual territory with white and dark neutral contrast, while adapting the palette to the specific flavor SKU.

Color should create:

* Freshness
* Energy
* Cleanliness
* Flavor recognition
* Strong product separation

Do not overload the artwork with unrelated colors.

PHASE 5: PRODUCT COMPOSITION

Create a sophisticated commercial product composition.

The Trident pack should occupy a strong hero position with realistic scale, perspective, and contact with the environment.

Use:

* Dramatic perspective
* Layered depth
* Foreground elements
* Midground product interaction
* Atmospheric background
* Intentional negative space
* Strong visual diagonals
* Controlled cropping

The product must feel physically present inside the scene.

Use realistic contact shadows, reflections, surface interaction, and material behavior.

PHASE 6: GRAPHIC DESIGN & COLLAGE

Introduce graphic elements only when they strengthen the concept:

* Oversized typography
* Flavor labels
* Small technical information
* Editorial numbering
* Graphic lines
* Cropped shapes
* Repeated product details
* Subtle geometric elements
* Microcopy

Create visual tension between photographic realism and graphic design.

Avoid turning the poster into a template or a cluttered collage.

PHASE 7: TYPOGRAPHY

Create one short, memorable campaign headline connected directly to the visual idea.

Possible direction:

“CHEW THE MOMENT.”
“FRESH HITS DIFFERENT.”
“UNWRAP THE FRESH.”
“FRESHNESS, UNLEASHED.”
“FEEL THE FLAVOR.”
“MAKE ROOM FOR FRESH.”

Use bold, contemporary uppercase typography with strong editorial presence.

Typography should become part of the visual composition.

Allow oversized type to interact with the environment, overlap atmospheric elements, disappear behind objects, or extend beyond the frame where appropriate.

Maintain perfect spelling, clean letterforms, strong hierarchy, and commercial readability.

PHASE 8: BRAND INTELLIGENCE

Maintain Trident’s core communication territory:

* Freshness
* Flavor
* Everyday confidence
* Social connection
* Energy
* Approachability
* Contemporary culture
* Playful sophistication

Use the Trident logo correctly and prominently enough for immediate brand recognition without making the artwork feel like a packaging mockup.

Do not imitate a specific existing Trident campaign.

Create a completely original visual concept using the brand’s established identity.

PHASE 9: SOCIAL MEDIA ART DIRECTION

Format: 4:5 vertical Instagram poster.

Design specifically for mobile viewing.

The composition must:

* Stop the scroll immediately
* Communicate the idea within one second
* Make the product recognizable at thumbnail size
* Have one dominant focal point
* Maintain strong contrast
* Use clear visual hierarchy
* Feel premium when viewed full-screen
* Remain readable without zooming

The artwork should look equally strong as an Instagram post, paid social advertisement, and campaign carousel cover.

PHASE 10: COMMERCIAL FINISH

Create the finish of a world-class FMCG advertising campaign.

Use:

* Photorealistic product rendering
* Premium commercial lighting
* Realistic packaging materials
* High-detail textures
* Controlled reflections
* Accurate shadows
* Natural depth of field
* Sophisticated retouching
* Subtle atmospheric detail
* Sharp product edges
* Print-quality detail

Avoid:

* Generic AI aesthetics
* Plastic-looking packaging
* Warped logos
* Incorrect text
* Fake product geometry
* Duplicate products
* Random objects
* Excessive glow
* Excessive particles
* Cheap CGI
* Over-saturated colors
* Unnecessary visual clutter
* Stock-photo appearance

FINAL OUTPUT:

Create a world-class Trident chewing gum social advertisement where the product, advertising idea, environment, typography, color system, photography, and graphic design feel conceived as one unified campaign.

The final image should feel playful enough for social media, sophisticated enough for a global FMCG brand, and visually distinctive enough to be immediately recognizable in a crowded Instagram feed.

Premium FMCG advertising. Bold visual metaphor. Photorealistic product. Editorial graphic design. Fresh, energetic, culturally relevant, scroll-stopping.

title: Create a world-class official premium automotive campaign...
prompt:
Create a world-class official premium automotive campaign poster for the Ford F-150 Raptor, designed as a dark layered performance key visual that merges Orbit-level vehicle realism, Port-level brand-performance storytelling, and a more mature OEM-style micro-data system. The image must fully preserve the exact composition logic, layered two-vehicle staging, editorial poster rhythm, and premium product hierarchy of a luxury automotive ad layout: one monumental rear three-quarter Ford F-150 Raptor dominating the upper half as a sculptural background statement, and one front three-quarter Ford F-150 Raptor occupying the lower center foreground as the main hero product. The final artwork must feel powerful, official, technically disciplined, factory-authentic, visually premium, and globally credible.

Core composition:
Use a tall vertical poster with a dark cinematic environment and a layered composition. In the upper half, place one massive Ford F-150 Raptor in a rear three-quarter or side-rear angle, filling most of the width and acting as the dominant upper sculpture. In the lower half, place a second view of the same truck in a front three-quarter stance, centered and slightly closer to the viewer, clearly becoming the primary hero. Separate both layers with soft atmospheric haze, restrained mist, and controlled tonal depth. Add a large curved dark graphic shape from one side to frame the composition and reinforce the premium editorial structure.

Vehicle authenticity:
Render a factory-authentic Ford F-150 Raptor with exact OEM proportions, official FORD grille lettering, correct headlamp and taillamp geometry, hood venting, flared fenders, side steps, skid plate, tow hooks, wide-body stance, bed proportions, wheel design, and tire scale. The truck must look like a true production F-150 Raptor with no fantasy modifications. Use an official-looking dark premium body color such as Agate Black or Carbonized Gray, with realistic metallic paint behavior, subtle micro dust on lower surfaces, deep reflective bodywork, and believable trim contrast.

Orbit-level realism:
Push the realism of the lower hero truck harder. Emphasize the depth and materiality of the FORD grille lettering, the precision of the headlamp internals, the contact weight of the tires on the wet surface, the subtle wheel-arch shadowing, the ride-height stance, and the paint highlight roll-off across the hood, doors, and bed side. Wet ground reflections, tire sidewall texture, brake hardware depth, and lower body dust residue should all feel exceptionally real and physically convincing. The truck must feel heavy, expensive, and unmistakably official.

Upper vehicle layer:
The upper truck should emphasize muscular rear volume, tailgate character, rear lamp identity, wheel presence, bed-side surfacing, and overall silhouette authority. It should feel monumental and premium, like a background power statement. Use low atmospheric mist around the lower wheels and body edge to separate it from the lower hero truck without obscuring details.

Lower hero vehicle:
The lower truck must be the main sales focus, shown in a commanding front three-quarter angle with planted off-road stance and high-performance road presence. The front fascia, grille mesh, headlight internals, wheel finish, tire blocks, body reflection, and underbody shadow structure must all be masterfully rendered. It should feel like the official vehicle hero from a global OEM campaign.

Environment:
Place the truck in a dark premium outdoor setting with wet asphalt or hard-packed off-road ground reflecting soft light. Add subtle road moisture, fine mist, faint dust, and cinematic background atmosphere, but keep the surroundings abstracted and minimal so the vehicle remains dominant. The environment must support a luxury-performance campaign mood without visual clutter.

Lighting:
Use sophisticated cinematic automotive lighting with overcast-sky drama combined with studio-grade highlight control. Show elegant reflection roll-off across the body panels, clean glass reflections, subtle wheel sheen, refined taillight and headlamp definition, and premium contour separation. Lighting should be dark and moody but highly informative, never hiding the truck’s key forms.

Material realism:
Render every automotive material with master-level fidelity: metallic paint, gloss trim, matte black plastics, grille textures, tire rubber, machined alloy surfaces, glass, mirror housings, tow-hook coatings, wet asphalt reflection, and lower-body dust interaction. The final image must feel de-AI, precise, and production-grade.

OEM micro-data system:
Standardize the lower information strip into a mature OEM-style data layout with compact premium engineering categories. Use refined English micro-headings such as:
POWERTRAIN
3.5L High-Output EcoBoost V6

OUTPUT
450 hp / 510 lb-ft

DRIVELINE
4x4 / 10-speed automatic

SUSPENSION
FOX Live Valve shocks

CAPABILITY
Baja-tuned off-road response

Keep these fields aligned in a clean horizontal strip with restrained dividers, uniform spacing, and minimal icon support if needed. The strip must feel like official manufacturer campaign typography, not brochure clutter.

Port-level brand completion:
Elevate the poster into a more complete official performance-brand image. Add restrained metadata such as:
Series Name: F-150 Raptor
Vehicle Class: High-Performance Off-Road Truck
Performance Line: Ford Performance
Platform Ref.: F-Series Architecture
Off-Road Protocol: Baja-Calibrated Terrain Response
These fields must be integrated subtly and elegantly, reinforcing the feeling of an official global OEM campaign.

Typography and branding:
Use only English text. At the top, add minimal refined metadata such as:
FORD PERFORMANCE
F-150 RAPTOR
HIGH-OUTPUT OFF-ROAD TRUCK

At the bottom center, create a strong official title block:
FORD F-150 RAPTOR
DESERT-BRED. STREET-DOMINANT.

Below that, add one short premium descriptor:
Engineered for advanced terrain control, high-speed durability, and commanding presence.

Add a small official Ford oval logo in a tasteful lower-left or lower-center position. Typography must feel bold, modern, globally premium, and officially automotive.

Color direction:
Use a refined palette of black, graphite, charcoal, gunmetal gray, muted silver highlights, wet asphalt reflections, and restrained white typography. Keep the entire image dark, bold, sophisticated, and tightly unified.

Commercial goal:
The final artwork must feel like an award-level official Ford F-150 Raptor campaign poster: technically accurate, visually commanding, OEM-authentic, highly realistic, product-led, and globally credible. Preserve the exact layered upper-vehicle plus lower-hero-vehicle composition and elevate it into a stronger, more mature, more official performance-truck advertising image.

title: Create an ultra-premium fragrance advertising poster for ...
prompt:
Create an ultra-premium fragrance advertising poster for Dior Sauvage, built around one hyper-real perfume bottle as the absolute hero product, placed in the center of an extreme wild forest environment on top of a dark wet stone. The composition must feel raw, elegant, masculine, primal, and luxurious, like a world-class high-fashion fragrance campaign. The bottle must remain the clear visual protagonist, while the surrounding environment expresses the scent’s wild mineral identity through wet forest textures, cool moisture, drifting micro-dust, soft backlight, and a single black panther tail used as a sculptural compositional element. The final image must feel cinematic, highly realistic, and premium, with powerful visual tension but extreme control.

Core composition:
Use a tall vertical composition with the Dior Sauvage bottle positioned centrally on a dark wet stone or low forest rock pedestal. The bottle must stand upright and dominant. Around it, build a refined natural stage of damp forest floor, moss, roots, wet stone surfaces, faint decayed botanical traces, and subtle atmospheric mist. A black panther tail must enter the composition as the key animal symbol, curving elegantly around the lower foreground or side of the bottle in a way that creates a strong visual rhythm and frames the product without covering important branding. The tail should feel alive, powerful, sensual, and controlled, like a dark signature stroke inside the forest.

Milk Cloud Orbit + Cream Halo Transit direction:
Push the strongest established qualities further: intensify the hero-bottle dominance, refine the panther-tail arc into an even more deliberate compositional gesture, and shift the forest environment toward a quieter, more open, more sacred space. Keep the same bottle-tail-wet-stone skeleton, but make the background breathe more by reducing visual density and softening the distant forest into a more abstract field of shadow and haze. The result should feel colder, more premium, more mineral, and more iconic, like a solitary relic of scent inside a sacred wilderness.

Product realism:
Render the Dior Sauvage bottle with obsessive realism and luxury material fidelity. Show the iconic bottle form with deep midnight-blue to near-black glass, subtle smoky transparency, cool internal liquid density, premium cap finish, immaculate branding, crisp edges, and elegant reflections. The glass must feel cold, heavy, and expensive. Tiny moisture traces or condensation can appear subtly on the surrounding surface, but the bottle itself must remain pristine and heroically presented.

Forest environment:
Build an extreme natural wild environment with premium realism. Use wet dark stones, moss, roots, damp earth, fractured bark, decayed wood, and only a few restrained forest-floor elements. The setting should feel like a deep primal forest after rain, rich in moisture and shadow, but kept clean and highly art-directed. Reduce the density of the distant forest so the space behind the bottle becomes more open and more meditative. Let the deeper tree forms dissolve into soft shadow, blur, and mist rather than remaining graphically defined. The world should feel raw, mineral, damp, and sacred.

Black panther tail logic:
Use a black panther tail as the only animal element, never showing the full animal. The tail must feel sleek, muscular, elegant, and predatory, with ultra-real black fur, subtle sheen, natural curvature, and realistic weight. It should enter the composition in a highly controlled way, curling around the bottle or across the foreground like a calligraphic stroke, enhancing the feeling of untamed sophistication. The tail must not overwhelm the product. It is a symbolic presence, not the hero.

Water, moisture, and stone realism:
Render the wet stones and forest moisture with exceptional realism. Show slick rock surfaces, dark mineral sheen, tiny droplets, subtle runnels of water, wet moss, humid air, and faint mist drifting through the lower frame. If water is visible, it should be calm, shallow, and controlled rather than splashing dramatically. The scene must feel humid, cool, and alive, with exquisite micro-detail in every wet surface.

Lighting:
Use extremely delicate soft cinematic forest light. The main light should come from above and behind, filtering through the trees in pale warm-to-neutral beams, creating refined highlights on the bottle edges, cap, wet stones, and panther tail fur. The rest of the image should remain in cool dark green-black shadow with subtle atmospheric depth. Let the background forest dissolve into softer luminous haze and quieter depth. The lighting must feel sacred, restrained, and luxurious, never harsh and never flashy.

Atmosphere:
Add subtle floating dust, fine moisture particles, soft drifting forest mist, and a few delicate shafts of filtered light. These elements must feel physically believable and premium, enhancing the scent’s wild natural aura. Keep the air alive but controlled. The scene should feel like a sacred hidden clearing rather than a busy landscape. Make the distant atmosphere quieter, emptier, and more still.

Background:
Pull the background further open. Let the deeper tree shadows become softer, more blurred, and more silent. Reduce visual busyness and allow more negative atmospheric space behind the bottle. The distant forest should feel present but withdrawn, like an immense quiet darkness with only faint layered tree memory and mist.

Color direction:
Use a refined palette of deep forest green, black, charcoal, wet stone gray, midnight blue glass, subtle silver reflections, and muted warm light accents. Keep the world dark, cool, and mineral with only restrained golden highlights from the filtered light. The overall mood must feel masculine, wild, luxurious, and elegant.

Typography and branding:
Add a refined English main title such as “DIOR SAUVAGE” in a premium editorial fragrance layout, with only minimal support text if needed. Include subtle official-feeling Dior branding logic, but keep all text sparse, quiet, and spatially integrated. Typography must feel luxurious and controlled, not loud. The product and the environment must remain visually dominant.

wild, primal, luxurious, damp, mineral, masculine, elegant, restrained, mysterious, cinematic, collectible, sacred

Milk Cloud Orbit + Cream Halo Transit direction:

The motion should feel sculptural, clean, and luxurious, never chaotic. Use dry sand, textured soil, scorched mineral ground, broken earth, and elegant weathered dead wood or exposed root-like structures as the core environmental language. Add only the faintest traces of withered flowers or dried plant remains if they help the scent narrative, but keep them nearly fossil-like and extremely sparse. The forms must feel tactile, cracked, sun-dried, and elegant, not messy. They should add geological age and memory to the scene rather than rustic decoration. Everything should feel restrained, elemental, and intentional.

Use extremely delicate, soft, cinematic desert light. The lighting should feel warm, low-angle, and premium, like late golden-hour sun filtered through dry atmosphere. It must sculpt the bottle edges, inner fragrance liquid, sand grains, dust particles, and root surfaces with exquisite precision. Use warm amber highlights, deep but soft shadow transitions, and subtle haze in the background. The lighting must feel luxurious, natural, and emotionally powerful, never harsh or artificial.

Background:
Keep the background minimal, atmospheric, and geographically suggestive. Use distant blurred desert tones, very low horizon landforms, soft warm sky glow, and controlled haze. The background must support the elemental theme without distracting from the bottle. No busy landscape detail. The feeling should be expansive, minimal, and almost sacred.

small natural gaps,
subtle leaning fruit or leaves,

some scattered petals, peels, seeds, or tea fragments,
tiny irregular overlaps,
slight asymmetry in edges,
small signs of gravity and real placement.

Product:
Place one hyper-realistic Chanel N°5 bottle in the composition as the central hero. The bottle must be unmistakably Chanel N°5: iconic rectangular crystal glass silhouette, elegant faceted cap, pale champagne-golden perfume liquid, crisp black-and-white label, luminous transparency, exquisite glass reflections, and perfect luxury realism. The bottle should feel pristine, silent, and precious.

Fusion logic:
The relationship between the bottle and the ink landscape must include a few carefully controlled points of fusion. Do not keep them fully separate, and do not over-blend them. The fusion should feel rare, subtle, and magical:
soft ink mist may seep from the lower bottle edge,
mountain ridges may appear to grow from the perfume’s inner golden glow,
waterfall-like white space may descend from the bottle base,
faint brush-wash textures may kiss the bottle’s outer contour,
a scroll-like ink terrain may partially dissolve into the transparent glass edge.

Ink-wash world:
Build a refined black-white-gray Chinese shan shui landscape with:
misty layered mountains,
ink cliffs,
pine trees,
flowing waterfalls,
soft clouds,
fog banks,
paper-like ink diffusion,
brush-washed contours,
subtle scroll texture,
and poetic negative space.
The landscape should feel highly sophisticated, airy, and painterly, never decorative or overloaded.

Composition:
Use a large amount of blank space. The bottle should remain central or slightly off-center, with the ink landscape unfolding asymmetrically from it in a graceful directional flow. The overall layout must feel breathable, quiet, and perfectly balanced, like a luxury gallery poster. Avoid symmetry and avoid crowding the frame.

Color palette:
Keep the image almost entirely monochrome:
rice-paper white,
ivory white,
mist gray,
ash gray,
deep ink black.
Use only a restrained touch of pale champagne gold from the Chanel N°5 liquid as the single warm accent. This minimal warmth should make the perfume feel sacred and luminous against the calm ink world.

Visual feeling:
The image must feel like the ultimate encounter between modern French perfume luxury and classical Eastern mountain poetry. It should suggest stillness, fragrance, memory, nature, and elegance without becoming literal or theatrical. The result should be exceptionally beautiful, soft, and emotionally transporting.

Typography:
Typography must be extremely restrained and elegant, like a museum label or couture fragrance campaign. No cluttered copy.

Use:
“CHANEL”
“N°5”

Optional very subtle Chinese support:

“山水由香而生”
“于留白与墨意之间，见永恒”

The text should be small, airy, and placed only within the negative space.

Lighting and rendering:
Use soft premium light on the bottle, with crystal highlights, subtle shadowing, and immaculate material realism. The ink landscape should feel feathered, atmospheric, and painterly, while the bottle remains sharp, tactile, and ultra-real. The contrast between glass precision and ink softness must be extraordinary. 8k, hyper-detailed, luxury fragrance campaign quality, visually unforgettable.

title: 2x2 grid, 16:9, do this for 4 x fortune 500 companies: --...
prompt:
2x2 grid, 16:9, do this for 4 x fortune 500 companies: -- Input: [Subject]
-- ── INFERENCE LAYER ────────────────────────────────────────────
WITH inferred AS (
  SELECT
    infer_iconic_silhouette([Subject]) AS logo,
    infer_brand_color([Subject])        AS primary_color,
    infer_era_typography([Subject])     AS typeface,
    infer_eight_milestones([Subject])   AS milestones,
    infer_historical_artifacts([Subject], 30) AS artifacts
),
-- ── HEADER ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
header_block AS (
  SELECT
    render_typography(
      text := [Subject],
      font := typeface,
      fill := primary_color,
      position := 'top'
    ) AS header
  FROM inferred
),
-- ── LOGO MASK & COLLAGE ────────────────────────────────────────
collage_block AS (
  SELECT
    render_logo_mask(inferred.logo, inferred.primary_color) AS mask,
    array_agg(
      render_halftone_artifact(a.artifact)
      ORDER BY random()
    ) AS packed_artifacts
  FROM inferred, unnest(inferred.artifacts) AS a(artifact)
  GROUP BY inferred.logo, inferred.primary_color
),
-- ── TIMELINE ───────────────────────────────────────────────────
timeline_block AS (
  SELECT
    render_timeline(
      nodes := inferred.milestones,
      style := 'vintage_icon_nodes'
    ) AS timeline
  FROM inferred
),
-- ── COMPOSITE ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
composite AS (
  SELECT
    compose(
      paper     := 'aged_cream',
      header    := header_block.header,
      mask      := collage_block.mask,
      artifacts := collage_block.packed_artifacts,
      timeline  := timeline_block.timeline
    ) AS poster
  FROM header_block, collage_block, timeline_block
)
-- ── FINAL RENDER ───────────────────────────────────────────────
SELECT render(composite.poster)
WITH
  style := 'vintage_screenprint_infographic',
  palette := (SELECT primary_color FROM inferred),
  resolution := '8K';
-- ── VALIDATION CHECKS ──────────────────────────────────────────
-- 1. exactly 8 milestones
-- 2. collage inside logo mask
-- 3. typography top-aligned
-- 4. strictly 2-color

title: Act as a High-End Product Photographer and CGI Artist.
prompt:
Act as a High-End Product Photographer and CGI Artist.

PHASE 1: SUBJECT & LOGIC
Generate a massive, perfectly centered, three-dimensional physical sculpture of the official, unaltered corporate logo for [BRAND NAME]. The sculpture must strictly adhere to the brand’s precise logo geometry and proportions (1:1 from brandbook). The sculpture is suspended in mid-air. Autonomously identify the exact official shape and structure of the [BRAND NAME] logo and render it as a single, flawless glass object without any modifications.
PHASE 2: MATERIALITY (GLASS)
The entire logo is made of hyper-realistic, optical-grade crystal glass (not water, not gel). The material is solid, colorless, and boasts high clarity with a high refractive index. The logo is suspended against a strictly clean, bright blue sky with sparse, naturally defined white cumulus clouds. NO land, NO trees, NO palms. The background is purely atmospheric. The focus is entirely on the glass logo. Critically render hyper-realistic, complex glass caustics: intense, sharp patterns of focused light and color (refractions of the blue sky) cast inside and onto the surface of the glass form due to the sunlight passing through it.

TECH SPECS
Rendered with Arnold or Octane. Phase One XF, 120mm Macro lens. Aperture f/5.6 for sharp depth across the entire glass sculpture. Intense, direct sunlight (hard lighting) to maximize caustics. Global illumination, ray-traced refractions (double-sided geometry), and chromatic aberration emulation (subtle) for optical realism. Fine grain film emulation (Fujifilm Velvia 50).

title: Create a premium 4-panel campaign poster for Nescafé, bui...
prompt:
Create a premium 4-panel campaign poster for Nescafé, built as a clean 2x2 grid of minimalist conceptual coffee ads. Each panel must feature a real Nescafé product or real coffee cup as the central hero, combined with a witty visual event or object transformation directly related to coffee. The overall composition should feel highly organized, brand-consistent, modern, and clever, with all four panels sharing the same saturated Nescafé-red background, premium lighting, minimal layout, and strong visual simplicity. The entire campaign should feel like one unified idea expressed through four different coffee moments.

Overall layout:
Use a perfectly balanced 2x2 square grid, each panel framed like an individual premium ad card within one larger poster. The background of every panel should be a rich saturated Nescafé red with subtle tonal variation and soft studio depth. Keep the whole design extremely minimal and clean, with generous negative space. Each panel contains one real coffee object and one clever event, transformation, or visual metaphor built around that object. Add the Nescafé logo consistently at the top of each panel, with short English taglines beneath or near the central visual.

Panel 1 – Wake:
A real top-view coffee cup becomes the starting point of a simple maze or route system, suggesting that coffee helps you find your way into the day. The cup should be rendered with extreme realism, rich black coffee surface, subtle crema details, and premium ceramic texture. The maze or route should be minimal white linework, highly graphic and clean, integrated naturally with the cup.

Panel 2 – Charge:
A real Nescafé jar or cup is visually connected to the idea of power or charging. For example, the product may be linked to a charging cable, battery icon logic, or a clean energy metaphor, but executed in a premium minimalist way. The product remains fully realistic, clearly readable, and visually dominant. The event must feel smart and instantly understandable, not gimmicky.

Panel 3 – Focus:
A real coffee cup or pair of coffee-filled sunglasses creates a visual metaphor for concentration, alertness, or mental sharpness. The object transformation must feel elegant and witty, with realistic coffee surface details and refined shadows. This panel should feel slightly more fashion-like and graphic, but still consistent with the system.

Panel 4 – Create:
A real coffee cup becomes the source of creativity through a clean event connected to steam, linework, or idea generation. For example, steam can subtly evolve into a lightbulb, idea sketch, signal line, or abstract brain-like shape. The visual must remain minimal and premium, with the coffee cup as the anchor and the event as the conceptual payoff.

Visual language:
Each panel must combine hyper-realistic product photography with very restrained white line graphics or minimal object transformations. The linework should feel polished, premium, and intelligent, never childish. The coffee objects should always remain the visual hero. The event or metaphor should look as if it naturally grows out of the product.

Branding and typography:
Use English as the dominant title language. Place the Nescafé logo clearly in each panel. Add a short, punchy English tagline for each concept, for example:
Panel 1: “Find Your Way”
Panel 2: “Charge Your Day”
Panel 3: “For More Focus”
Panel 4: “Brew the Idea”
Typography must be minimal, well-spaced, bold in hierarchy but still elegant, with no clutter or cheap poster styling.

Lighting:
Use polished commercial product lighting across all four panels. Coffee surfaces should have subtle reflections and realistic depth. Cups and jars should cast soft, clean shadows. The white graphics and visual metaphors should remain crisp and beautifully integrated. The entire campaign should feel premium, graphic, and expertly art-directed.

Mood:
minimal, clever, energetic, modern, premium, brand-forward, memorable, witty, editorial.

Rendering style:
hyper-realistic commercial coffee product photography combined with restrained conceptual white-line graphics, premium 4-grid campaign poster, saturated monochrome red branding background, elegant typography integration, polished advertising lighting, 8k, sharp but clean finish.

Negative prompt:
messy layout, cluttered props, weak product focus, low-detail coffee cup, cheap infographic style, childish doodles, flat lighting, distorted branding, random unrelated objects, low-end coffee ad, noisy composition

title: You are Architect Furniture Designer, a world-class princ...
prompt:
You are Architect Furniture Designer, a world-class principal designer and award-winning furniture architect with 20+ years of experience blending architectural principles with functional furniture design. You have deep expertise in modernism, brutalism, parametric design, biophilic architecture, and sustainable materials, having collaborated with leading architecture firms and exhibited at major design biennales.

Your core mission is to design innovative chairs or sofas that fuse distinctive architectural styles with integrated book holders or built-in shelves, creating functional, sculptural pieces that feel like miniature architecture.

### Rules & Constraints (never break these)
- Always prioritize structural integrity, ergonomic comfort, and aesthetic coherence.
- Designs must be original and unique — never copy existing products.
- Use sustainable or innovative materials where appropriate and explain material choices.
- Every design must clearly incorporate at least one integrated book holder or shelf system that feels natural to the architectural style.
- Be maximally creative while remaining realistic for potential fabrication.
- Use clear, professional, yet accessible language. Avoid jargon unless explaining a specific technique.

### Thinking Process (use this every time)
1. Understand the user's request, including any style references, constraints, or visual requirements (e.g., white background, aspect ratio).
2. Break the design into core components: overall architectural style, seating form, integrated storage, materials, ergonomics.
3. Explore multiple architectural influences internally (e.g., Bauhaus, Deconstructivism, Futurism, Organic, etc.) and select the strongest fit.
4. Generate detailed concepts with visual descriptions suitable for image generation.
5. Validate for feasibility, beauty, and usefulness. Ensure the book/shelf integration enhances rather than compromises the design.

### Response Style
- Tone: Professional yet inspiring and approachable.
- Depth: Provide both high-level vision and specific technical/creative details.
- Always use rich, vivid descriptions optimized for image generation prompts.
- Structure your final response clearly with sections: Concept Overview, Design Details, Material & Construction, Visual Rendering Prompt.

### Output Format
For every user request, deliver:
1. **Concept Name & Overview** — A striking title and 2-3 sentence summary.
2. **Architectural Inspiration & Key Features** — Explain the style and how the book/shelf integration works.
3. **Detailed Specifications** — Dimensions, seating ergonomics, materials, unique details.
4. **Image Generation Prompt** — A complete, highly optimized prompt ready for an image model, incorporating any user-specified requirements (e.g., white background, 9:16 ratio).

title: [BRAND NAME].
prompt:
[BRAND NAME].

Act as a Senior Industrial Designer and Technical Illustrator, specializing in pencil engineering sketch reproductions of brand logos (style: hand-drawn technical blueprint/concept sketch on aged paper).

PHASE 1: AGED PAPER SURFACE
A warm, aged beige-cream paper surface (#E8D5B0 range) filling the entire frame — with visible aging spots, worn patches, scattered pencil smudges, and fine paper grain consistent with a real old technical sketchbook or archival drawing sheet. Subtle vignette darkening at all frame edges. No clean digital white — the paper must read as genuinely old and physical.

PHASE 2: LOGO RECONSTRUCTED AS PENCIL TECHNICAL SKETCH (TRUE SHAPE)
[BRAND NAME]'s real, official primary icon/logomark is reproduced with full shape and proportional accuracy exactly as it appears in the brand's real guidelines, then rendered entirely as a hand-drawn pencil engineering sketch — as if a designer sketched the logo concept by hand in a technical drawing session. The logo is positioned in the center of the frame, occupying roughly 40–50% of frame height.

CRITICAL ACCURACY INSTRUCTION — NON-NEGOTIABLE: Do not invent, approximate, restructure, or substitute the logo with any other imagery. The logo's real geometry and proportions stay exactly as in the brand's real guidelines — only the pencil sketch rendering treatment is applied on top of the unchanged shape.

PHASE 3: PENCIL SKETCH TECHNIQUE (HERO EFFECT)
Two distinct pencil layers build the complete illustration:
- CONSTRUCTION LAYER (light pressure): thin, precise straight lines forming a rectangular bounding box around the logo's outer dimensions, plus internal diagonal construction/guide lines radiating from key structural points of the logo — all drawn with light pencil pressure, slightly imprecise, with the natural slight waviness of a hand-drawn straight line.
- LOGO LAYER (heavier pressure): the logo's actual forms drawn with firmer pencil pressure — clean but hand-drawn contour lines tracing the real logo shape, with dense diagonal crosshatch pencil shading filling the solid/dark areas of the logo to imply volume and depth. Shading direction is consistent (45-degree diagonal strokes), varying in density from light to dark across the form.

PHASE 4: TECHNICAL ANNOTATIONS
Around the logo, hand-drawn engineering dimension annotations in classic technical drawing style — rendered in thin pencil handwriting:
- Horizontal and vertical double-arrow dimension lines with end caps, indicating key measurements (written as plausible dimensions: "L=Xmm", "R=Xmm")
- Angle annotations for key diagonal elements (e.g. "10°", "OFFSET X°")
- All annotation text in a clean, slightly imperfect hand-lettered technical style — not a printed font, but the careful handwriting of a technical draftsman
- 4–6 annotation labels total, positioned logically around the bounding box and key logo elements

PHASE 5: COMPOSITION
Logo and annotations centered in the frame with generous aged-paper negative space surrounding them, especially above and below. No color, no additional graphic elements — strictly monochrome pencil on aged paper.

TECH SPECS:
Flat 2D pencil illustration, no 3D, no digital gradients — all tone from pencil pressure and crosshatch density. Monochrome: dark graphite pencil on warm aged paper. Resolution: 8K.

title: 元画像および指定された画風・配色・キャラクターの特徴を可能な限り忠実に維持しながら、画面全体の描写密度、質感、立体...
prompt:
元画像および指定された画風・配色・キャラクターの特徴を可能な限り忠実に維持しながら、画面全体の描写密度、質感、立体感、視覚的な迫力、芸術的な表現力を高める。

【描写密度・素材表現】

髪、肌、布、革、金属、ガラスなど、画面内に存在する素材それぞれの特性に応じて、繊細な陰影、複雑な反射、豊かなハイライト、自然な質感の違いを丁寧に描き分ける。

細部を安易に省略せず、素材固有の微細な凹凸、光沢、透過、重なり、表面の変化まで表現する。ただし、元の画風に存在しない質感を無理に付け加えず、その表現形式の延長として描写を豊かにする。

【光・陰影・色彩】

光と影には深みと強弱を持たせ、環境光の色の回り込み、反射光、間接光、微妙な色の変化を取り入れる。

単調な明暗や均一なライティングを避け、光源と周囲の環境に応じた複雑で説得力のある陰影を形成する。

白や明るい部分も単純な純白に固定せず、周囲の光や空気感を自然に反映させる。ただし、白の明快さが表現上重要な場合は、その美しさを損なわない。

特定の色相に偏らず、元画像やシーンに適した色彩バランスを維持しながら、色の深み、鮮やかさ、陰影の階調、色同士の相互作用を豊かにする。

明るさや彩度を一律に調整するのではなく、色の濃淡、温度差、反射色、局所的なコントラストによって印象的な画面を構築する。

【画風・表現の個性】

画面を過度にクリーン化・平坦化・単純化・均質化しない。

元の画風が持つ線の勢い、筆致、描き込みの密度、素材感、奥行き、空気感、独特の表現上の癖を積極的に活かす。

整いすぎた無機質な仕上がりを避け、必要に応じて線の強弱、色の揺らぎ、陰影の複雑さ、手描きらしい有機的な表情を残す。

【最重要：参照画像の意図を汲み取る構図設計】

参照画像を単なる外見の資料として扱わず、人物や被写体の魅力、表情、仕草、雰囲気、視線、空間の使い方、光の方向、画面全体の印象を読み取り、その画像が持つ表現上の意図を理解する。

新たに指定された制作テーマやシーンの目的を優先しながら、参照画像から読み取れる魅力や個性を、構図や演出に自然に反映させる。

構図の大胆さは、カメラアングルの極端さだけで判断しない。

視点、距離感、被写体の大きさ、前景と背景の関係、空間の奥行き、視線誘導、動きの方向、余白、光と影、画面内の密度差など、多様な要素を組み合わせて視覚的なインパクトを生み出す。

制作テーマと参照画像の特徴に応じて、自然な目線の高さ、俯瞰、ローアングル、斜めの視点、接写、広角的な遠近表現などから、最も効果的なものを柔軟に選択する。

特定のカメラアングルやポーズを優先的に使用せず、被写体やシーンの意図に最も適した視点を採用する。

大胆な構図が効果的な場合は、強い遠近法、非対称な配置、前景との重なり、意図的なフレーミング、スケール差などを積極的に活用する。

一方で、静けさ、繊細さ、親密さ、優雅さなどが重要なシーンでは、過度な遠近法や大げさなポーズに頼らず、視線、表情、距離感、余白、光の演出によって印象的な画面を作る。

構図を安全で無難な方向へ過度に補正しないが、大胆さを演出すること自体を目的にしない。

主役の魅力と作品の意図が最も強く伝わる構図を優先し、必要に応じて大胆で挑戦的な画面設計を採用する。

参照画像の構図やポーズを機械的に固定する必要はない。元画像が持つ魅力の本質を保ちながら、新しい構図、視点、ポーズ、演出へ自由に発展させる。

【ポーズ・人体・立体構造】

表情、視線、仕草、姿勢、身体の動きは、キャラクターの個性と制作テーマに合わせて自然に設計する。

動きや迫力が求められる場合は、躍動感のあるポーズや大胆な身体表現を積極的に取り入れる。

ただし、手指や人体の構造、関節のつながり、自然な重心、空間的な整合性は維持する。

難しいポーズを避けて無難な姿勢に戻すのではなく、選択したポーズを正確かつ魅力的に成立させる。

【情報量・空間表現】

細かな描写を単なるノイズや装飾として追加するのではなく、形状、材質、光源、空間構造に基づく意味のあるディテールとして描く。

主役だけでなく、背景や周囲の物体にも必要に応じた情報量と奥行きを与え、画面全体に自然な密度差と空間的な説得力を持たせる。

背景の描き込みは主役の魅力を損なわない範囲で調整し、作品の雰囲気や世界観を強めるために活用する。

【最終仕上げ】

元画像の画風や表現形式は変更せず、その画風ならではの魅力を最大限に引き出す。

単なる高精細で整った画像ではなく、細部まで鑑賞したくなる描写の豊かさ、印象に残る光と影、素材の存在感、作品独自の雰囲気を備えた、密度と迫力のあるビジュアルに仕上げる。

全体を無難にまとめることよりも、参照画像と制作テーマの魅力を深く理解し、それにふさわしい大胆さ、個性、意外性、表現力を引き出すことを重視する。

title: 【风格名称】
prompt:
【风格名称】
二维东方幻想剪影绘景，手绘动画关键视觉，平面化数字绘画艺术。
2D hand-painted Eastern fantasy animation key art, stylized planar digital illustration, graphic silhouette composition, decorative backlighting, painterly tapered strokes, non-photorealistic.
【二维绘画属性】
画面必须保持明确的二维平面绘画感。
人物、衣物、竹叶、月亮和环境都由概括的色块、清晰剪影、柔和笔刷与细长装饰性笔触组成。不要追求真实摄影、真实皮肤、真实布料物理或三维空间建模。
人物以深色平面剪影为主，不使用复杂的面部体积、皮肤纹理、毛孔、高光反射或真实肌肉结构。五官只通过极少量侧脸线条和边缘亮色表达。
衣物通过大片深色形状与细长、尖锐、羽毛状的二维笔触组成。衣摆边缘分解为大量方向统一的锥形笔触、纤维状色片和手绘残影，但仍然保持平面绘画效果。
【平面化光影】
光影不采用真实摄影式光照，而采用经过设计的二维明暗色块。
全画面只保留三组主要明度：
接近黑色的人物、发丝、衣料和竹林剪影；
柔和冷蓝色的巨大月轮；
明亮暖白与橙金色的装饰性发光区域。
不要在人物身上塑造完整的明暗转折。人物躯干和面部保持大面积深色，只在轮廓处增加极细、简化的冷色或暖色边缘光。
衣裙内部的暖光表现为大片平面化暖白色形状。这些亮色形状被深色衣物笔触切割，形成“亮底上覆盖黑色碎片”的视觉结构，而不是模拟真实透明布料的光学透射。
暖光边缘使用柔和的橙金色辉光和少量模糊扩散，但内部仍保持清晰、平面、装饰性的发光色块。
【发光衣裙结构】
先绘制一大片连续的暖白色发光底形，再在其上叠加：
深色长条衣料；
尖锐锥形笔触；
羽毛状碎片；
细长纤维线；
不规则黑色遮挡；
少量暖橙色边缘光。
不要从衣物材质出发计算光线，而要把发光区域当作平面构图中的一个巨大亮色图形。
最终效果像一片暖白色光，被大量深色手绘衣料笔触切割成复杂、华丽、流动的形状。
【人物造型】
人物采用二维东方幻想动画式造型：
约8.5头身；
小头、长颈、窄肩；
纤薄胸腔与细腰；
修长四肢；
极窄、优雅的身体剪影；
细长手指和脚踝；
身体曲线克制。
人物真实身体是一道狭长的深色形状。宽阔体量来自向外展开的长发、衣袖、披帛和衣摆。
不要使用写实人体、丰满身材、健美比例或三维角色建模结构。
【笔触】
使用数字手绘动画背景式笔触：
柔和宽笔刷铺设背景；
清晰深色形状塑造人物；
细长锥形笔触塑造头发；
羽毛状、刀片状笔触塑造衣摆；
少量柔边光晕连接亮部；
局部边缘略微粗糙，保留手绘感；
不追求每一处材质细节。
笔触应当流畅、概括、装饰性强，像高级二维动画电影的关键视觉，而不是照片描摹或3D渲染。
【空间层级】
使用二维动画式分层构图：
后景：柔和失焦的巨大月轮与冷蓝色夜空；
中景：边缘清楚的人物深色剪影；
前景：较大、较暗、略微模糊的竹叶和栏杆；
暖色叶片与衣裙亮部形成装饰性视觉框架。
空间深度来自图层遮挡、大小变化、边缘虚实和冷暖对比，不依赖真实景深、镜头光学或三维透视。
【色彩】
采用严格受控的冷暖双色体系：
冷色：
深蓝黑；
暗青灰；
月光灰蓝；
低饱和冰蓝。
暖色：
暖白；
淡奶油色；
蜜桃橙；
琥珀金；
少量焦橙色。
背景与人物保持大面积冷暗色，暖色只集中在发光衣裙、部分竹叶和少量漂浮叶片上。
色彩表现为清楚的二维色块，不使用复杂写实环境色反射。
【画面气质】
空灵、诗意、孤独、神秘、优雅，带有东方幻想二维动画电影的视觉气质。
画面应像一张经过精心绘制的二维动画关键帧或游戏剧情插画，而不是现场摄影、真人古装剧截图、写实电影概念图或3D游戏画面。
【严格避免】
避免照片写实、真人摄影、电影摄影质感、半写实皮肤、真实毛孔、真实布料材质、PBR渲染、光线追踪、体积建模、CG角色、3D游戏截图。

Strengthen the sense that these graphics are not just hovering, but actively shaping and explaining the lower model. Keep them beautifully spaced and never cluttered.

Warm taupe-beige background, honey wood tones, white drafting lines, pale translucent trees, soft gray shadows, and a subtle golden sunlight wash. Keep everything restrained, premium, and coherent.

Subject and Action
A high-end travel editorial diorama featuring eight distinct global regions emerging from a singular, weathered vintage postcard. Eight stylized vinyl collectible figures, each dressed in authentic cultural attire—including an Egyptian traveler in a white galabeya, a Japanese figure in a modern haori, and a Saudi traveler with a falcon—are positioned within their respective miniature landscapes, captured in moments of quiet wonder and discovery.

Composition and Framing
The scene is shot from a slightly elevated 45-degree angle to emphasize the depth of the papercraft construction. The composition follows a clear hierarchy: a softly blurred montage of global landmarks creates a dreamy, cinematic background, leading the eye toward the oversized, textured vintage postcard. From this base, an intricate, multi-layered 3D papercraft world rises, featuring iconic landmarks like the Great Pyramid, Mount Fuji, Hegra tombs, the Colosseum, the Parthenon, La Sagrada Familia, the Eiffel Tower, and Dutch canal houses.

Warm golden-hour illumination bathes the diorama, casting soft, realistic shadows that define the edges of the paper layers. The color palette is a sophisticated blend of warm amber, cool teal, and soft lavender, evoking a sense of nostalgia and wanderlust. The atmosphere is serene and dreamlike, with a shallow depth of field that keeps the focus sharp on the handcrafted details of the stamps, handwritten ink notes, and the textured paper surfaces.

Material and Texture
The diorama is crafted from premium, high-quality textured paper with visible fibers and delicate edges. The vinyl figures have a smooth, matte finish that contrasts with the fibrous quality of the papercraft landscape. Macro-level details include authentic-looking postage stamps, precise postal cancellation marks, and delicate ink calligraphy that swirls across the postcard base, enhancing the tactile, artisanal quality of the piece.

Visual Style
Cinematic luxury editorial aesthetic, reminiscent of high-end travel magazines. The style prioritizes macro-photography precision, emphasizing the craftsmanship of the paper art and the expressive, detailed design of the collectible figures. The transition between the flat postcard and the 3D landscape is seamless, creating a seamless blending of reality and fantasy.

Constraints
No text, no watermarks, no logos. The figures must remain perfectly scaled to their environment without distortion. Do not use oversaturated neon colors or plastic textures on the paper elements. Ensure the handwriting and stamp details remain crisp and legible. Avoid any low-key, heavy shadows that might obscure the intricate papercraft regions.
